toggles.label: Drop rate
toggles.desc: Total Drop Rarity multiplier applied to every drop-table roll.

toggles.label: Coin multiplier
toggles.desc: Monster coin multiplier (MonsterCash). Each coin drop is base × (random + 0.5) × this.

toggles.label: Card drop chance multiplier
toggles.desc: Multiplier on every card drop chance.

toggles.label: Rares Everywhere! bonus
toggles.desc: Talent bonus that boosts rare drop-table rows.

toggles.label: Tracking Chips bribe
toggles.desc: Bribe bonus used by card drop rolls.

toggles.label: Tagged Indicators bribe
toggles.desc: Bribe bonus used by card drop rolls.

toggles.label: Star sign ring drop bonus
toggles.desc: Star sign bonus to ring drops.

toggles.label: Arcanist double drop (type 0)
toggles.desc: Arcanist DoubleItemDropz chance for the first item family.

toggles.label: Arcanist double drop (type 1)
toggles.desc: Arcanist DoubleItemDropz chance for the second item family.

toggles.label: Legend statue/golden food doubling
toggles.desc: Legend talent bonus that can double statue and golden food drops.

toggles.label: Spelunk shop statue doubling
toggles.desc: Spelunking shop bonus that can double statue drops.

toggles.label: Pirate Flag bonus
toggles.desc: Pirate Flag talent drop bonus (first value).

toggles.label: Pirate Flag secondary
toggles.desc: Pirate Flag talent secondary value.

toggles.label: Primo Prisma (Prisma bubble drops)
toggles.desc: Chance bonus for Prisma bubble drops.

toggles.label: Medallions already found
toggles.desc: Medallion types already found. On marks every medallion found, so none drop; Off clears the list, so every eligible medallion can drop.

toggles.label: Kills credited per kill
toggles.desc: Overrides the live KillPerKill credit (multikill, chain, overkill). Off = 1 credit per kill.

toggles.label: Multikill total %
toggles.desc: Overrides the live MultiKillTOTAL used while overkill is active.

toggles.label: Overkill active
toggles.desc: Forces overkill on or off instead of comparing max damage against the AFK target.

toggles.label: Overkill exponent
toggles.desc: Damage-to-HP ratio per overkill tier (2 normally, 5 on World 7 maps).

toggles.label: Multikill vial bonus
toggles.desc: Alchemy vial bonus added to every kill credit (÷ 100).

toggles.label: Active Murdering (kill credit)
toggles.desc: Vault upgrade bonus to active kill credit.

toggles.label: Extra cave kills
toggles.desc: Cavern kill-counter multiplier for cave monsters.

toggles.label: EXP multiplier
toggles.desc: Monster EXP multiplier (ExpMulti).

toggles.label: Family EXP bonus
toggles.desc: Family bonus to monster EXP.

toggles.label: Card EXP bonus
toggles.desc: Card bonus to monster EXP.

toggles.label: Active Learning
toggles.desc: Vault upgrade bonus to active monster EXP.

toggles.label: Star sign active EXP
toggles.desc: Star sign bonus to active EXP.

toggles.label: Crescent Shrine
toggles.desc: Shrine EXP bonus (map-gated).

toggles.label: Crystal mob drop & EXP multiplier
toggles.desc: Crystal Embiggener: max(1, Crystal Spawn ÷ cap). Multiplies crystal-mob drops, orb credit, and crystal EXP. Off = 1×.

toggles.label: Crystal spawn chance
toggles.desc: Uncapped crystal spawn chance per kill, before the cap. The Embiggener is a separate input.

toggles.label: Crystal spawn chance cap
toggles.desc: Cap on the per-kill crystal spawn chance (0.1 in the source).

toggles.label: Crystal respawn chip
toggles.desc: Lab chip chance for a killed crystal to respawn.

toggles.label: Crystal Countdown
toggles.desc: Talent value gating extra crystal behavior on crystal kills.

toggles.label: Giant mob spawn chance
toggles.desc: Chance per kill for a giant mob to spawn.

toggles.label: Giant spawn bubble
toggles.desc: Alchemy bubble bonus to giant spawns.

toggles.label: Glitterbug (giant → crystals)
toggles.desc: Prayer that converts giant kills into crystal spawns.

toggles.label: Marble drop chance
toggles.desc: Royal marble drop chance before the active streak factor.

toggles.label: Parchment drop chance
toggles.desc: Royal parchment drop chance per kill.

toggles.label: Parchment double chance
toggles.desc: Chance for a parchment drop to double.

toggles.label: Active kill outpost clearing
toggles.desc: Royal outpost clearing from active kills (0 = locked).

toggles.label: Regal Intervention chance
toggles.desc: Chance per kill to trigger Regal Intervention.

toggles.label: Regal Intervention mobs
toggles.desc: Extra mobs spawned by Regal Intervention.

toggles.label: L3 Royal Rewards (orb counter)
toggles.desc: Research grid bonus added to the orb kill counter per kill.

toggles.label: Starting orb kill count
toggles.desc: Orb kill counter at the start of the run.

toggles.label: Zenith extra cluster drops
toggles.desc: Zenith Market bonus to Zenith cluster drops.

toggles.label: Zenith statue EXP chance
toggles.desc: Chance, each time a Zenith Cluster forms, to add the whole statue stack as Statue EXP. The game always uses 69% because of a code bug, so EMULSION levels have no effect.

toggles.label: Grimoire Wraith form
toggles.desc: Death Bringer Wraith form. On starts the run already in form (cast before entering the map), so its stats and drops apply; Off removes a saved form buff; Auto uses the save.

toggles.label: Compass Tempest form
toggles.desc: Wind Walker Tempest form. On starts the run already in form (cast before entering the map), so its stats and drops apply; Off removes a saved form buff; Auto uses the save.

toggles.label: Tesseract Arcanist form
toggles.desc: Arcane Cultist Arcanist form. On starts the run already in form (cast before entering the map), so its stats and drops apply; Off removes a saved form buff; Auto uses the save.

toggles.label: Monster HP scale
toggles.desc: Multiplier on monster HP after all reductions.

toggles.label: Respawn rate bonus
toggles.desc: Per-monster respawn bonus %. Off removes every bonus; Scale multiplies each.

toggles.label: Max damage
toggles.desc: Player max damage per hit.

toggles.label: Crit chance %
toggles.desc: Player critical hit chance (percent; over 100 enables multi-crits).

toggles.label: Crit damage multiplier
toggles.desc: Critical hit damage multiplier.

toggles.label: Hit chance %
toggles.desc: Chance for a player hit to land.

toggles.label: Accuracy
toggles.desc: Total accuracy (also gates overkill).

toggles.label: Attack speed %
toggles.desc: Attack speed pool used by the auto-attack wait time.

toggles.label: Skill cooldown divisor
toggles.desc: Attack cooldown reduction divisor.

toggles.label: Movement speed
toggles.desc: Player movement speed (pixels per frame).

toggles.label: Max HP
toggles.desc: Player max HP.

toggles.label: Max MP
toggles.desc: Player max MP.

toggles.label: Defence
toggles.desc: Player total defence.

toggles.label: Boss damage multiplier
toggles.desc: Damage multiplier against bosses.

toggles.label: Auto-respawn time (s)
toggles.desc: Seconds before the player respawns after dying.

toggles.label: Kill heal %
toggles.desc: Percent of max HP healed per kill.

toggles.label: Wand hits Arcane-shielded mobs
toggles.desc: Tesseract upgrade that lets wand attacks hit monsters with an Arcane status shield.

toggles.label: Auto loot
toggles.desc: Auto-loot bundle pickup. Off leaves drops on the ground for the player to collect. Inventory slots still come from the saved bundle.

toggles.label: Inventory slots
toggles.desc: Inventory slots owned (bag-full behavior).
